purpose: Current Archaeology Guild qualification/shop progression that materially changes excavation throughput, storage, relic loadouts, collection completion and late-game mattock access.

relic_loadout_progression.requirement: Complete the Archaeology tutorial / relic-system onboarding
relic_loadout_progression.effect: Two relic loadouts are available; each can hold up to three relic powers.
Purchase an additional relic loadout tab from the Archaeology Guild Shop.
Fourth and final relic loadout tab is awarded by the Guildmaster qualification.

loadout_switching_rule.activation_cost_rule: Switching the active loadout costs 80% of the normal chronote harness cost for relics on the selected loadout; relics shared with the currently active loadout still contribute to the activation cost.

shop_progression.planner_value: First permanent throughput/storage tier; cheap enough to matter early in an accelerated League.

upgrades.name: Archaeologist's outfit
upgrades.effect: Regular skilling outfit; 6% Archaeology XP with full set

upgrades.name: Auto-screener v1.080 blueprint
upgrades.effect: Unlocks the blueprint; 67 Invention is required to discover/manufacture the device

shop_progression.planner_value: Auto-screener is the major Associate breakpoint; it can make later soil-box upgrades optional depending on relic/loadout choice.

upgrades.name: Additional relic loadout
upgrades.effect: Unlocks the third relic loadout tab

shop_progression.planner_value: Professor is the full-storage breakpoint and the purchasable third-loadout breakpoint.

upgrades.name: Master archaeologist's outfit
upgrades.effect: 7% excavation success, 7% screening success, 7% mattock base precision, faster restore/screening, longer consumables, collector/dig-site teleports, and unlocks the daily Fixate allowance

upgrades.name: Energised meteorite shard
upgrades.effect: Required for the Mattock of Time and Space

shop_progression.planner_value: Late Archaeology throughput/infrastructure breakpoint. Mattock of Time and Space access depends on the Guildmaster shop shard rather than level alone.

collection_completion_infrastructure.name: Fixate
collection_completion_infrastructure.requirement: Wear the full master archaeologist's outfit
collection_completion_infrastructure.effect: Choose an artefact from the targeted excavation and guarantee it on the next artefact discovery, consuming one Fixate energy.
collection_completion_infrastructure.planner_value: Late-game collection balancing tool. It reduces duplicate-artefact variance when finishing qualification counts, tetracompass loops, relic collections and other logs; it does not improve excavation speed by itself.

collection_completion_infrastructure.name: Fixate charge token
collection_completion_infrastructure.effect: Unlocks Fixate if necessary and grants one additional Fixate energy.
collection_completion_infrastructure.league_rule: Do not assume a deterministic token farm in Equilibrium. The token historically came from promotions/events and Treasure Hunter was removed in January 2026; only count tokens if the League or current game explicitly supplies them.

stale_data_correction.old_claim: Guildmaster grants the second relic loadout tab.
stale_data_correction.corrected_claim: Two presets are unlocked from tutorial onboarding; Professor can buy the third for 80,000 chronotes; Guildmaster awards the fourth.
